description: Lush long hall for ballad vocals. Programs the LongHall FX wet-only at unity, feeds from Vocal send slot 3. Verses stay on the hidden hall.
name: vocal-long
notes: Precondition: FX track LongHall with hall reverb slot 0; Vocal send slot 3 assigned to it (one-time setup in Cubase).
Multi-track preset: select LongHall for calls 2-4, then select Vocal for calls 5-7. Confirm with session.status before each group.
Response param field shows resolved titles; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling.
